learning_objectives: Understand main axis vs cross axis alignment in Flexbox
Master justify-content, align-items, and flex-wrap properties
Build a responsive multi-column layout without media queries
content.body_html:
What is CSS Flexbox?

Flexbox (Flexible Box Layout) is a 1D layout model designed to distribute space along a single axis (row or column). It resolves historic float hacks and provides sub-second layout alignment.

code_examples.title: Centering Content Perfectly with Flexbox

common_mistakes.mistake: Applying justify-content to flex items instead of flex container
common_mistakes.solution: Apply justify-content and align-items to the parent container element (`display: flex;`).

practice_challenge.task: Create a 3-card product pricing row using `display: flex` and `gap: 20px` that stacks vertically on mobile screens.
practice_challenge.hint: Use `flex-wrap: wrap` on the container so cards wrap cleanly.
